Operating Characteristics for Comparing Means

Source: R/class_operating_charcteristics.R
OperatingCharcteristicsMeans.Rd

Stores fixed-design quantitative decision probabilities for means. Obtain instances through getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans().

Details

Inherits sample sizes, probabilities, priors and controlMean from OperatingCharcteristics. The rates priors priorDist1 and priorDist2 remain NULL.

Inherited fields

probabilities

Calculated data frame of decision-category probabilities. Frequentist results store six categories; Bayesian results store Go, Indeterminate 1, Indeterminate 2 and Stop. Within each sample-size scenario, categories form blocks retaining supplied effect order and repeats. Probabilities are on the scale 0 to 1.

priorDist

Supplied normal-mixture effect prior (RBesT normMix) or a two-element list of control and treatment mean priors, in that order. NULL for frequentist results and rates results. Default Bayesian effect prior is mixnorm(c(1, 0, 100)).

priorDist1

Supplied RBesT betaMix prior for the treatment event probability. NULL for frequentist results and means results. Default Bayesian prior is mixbeta(c(1, 1/3, 1/3)).

priorDist2

Supplied RBesT betaMix prior for the control event probability. NULL for frequentist results and means results. Default Bayesian prior is mixbeta(c(1, 1/3, 1/3)).

controlMean

Single supplied true control mean when separate Bayesian mean priors are used. The true treatment mean is controlMean plus alternative. NULL for an effect prior, frequentist results and rates results.

See also

getDesignQuantitative(), getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans()

Super classes

FieldSet -> ParameterSet -> OperatingCharcteristics -> OperatingCharcteristicsMeans

Public fields

normalApproximation

TRUE for the normal sampling model used by the frequentist means calculation. For Bayesian means the model has known standard deviations and this field does not select a t approximation. Is a single logical value.

groups

Number of independent treatment groups, fixed at 2 (control and treatment). Is a single numeric value representing a whole number.

alternative

Supplied finite numeric vector of true treatment-minus-control mean differences. Order and repeated entries are retained for every sample-size scenario.

stDev

Supplied known standard deviation for means calculations. A positive scalar shared by both arms, or for Bayesian calculations a vector of two positive values ordered control, treatment. Bayesian OC plot data use the root mean square as the scalar SD facet label and retain both arm-specific values in four-category data.

OperatingCharcteristicsMeans$new()

Initializes means OC assumptions and probability output.

Usage

OperatingCharcteristicsMeans$new(
  ...,
  design,
  numberOfSubjects,
  normalApproximation = TRUE,
  groups = 2L,
  alternative = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
  stDev = 1,
  probabilities = NA_real_
